text:
Michael: Deploy blocked — deploy-bot flagged staging promote: artifact verification failed for `redwood/api:staging-2026-03-22` (digest mismatch). @tara can you take a look? https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/3301122334

deploy-bot: promote blocked by policy: `artifact-verify-failed` (code 409). Notifying oncall.

Tara: I see `checksum mismatch` in the registry finalization logs. Upload finished but final digest != expected. Looks like multipart upload finalization race. Snip from registry: ```PUT /v2/redwood/api/blobs/uploads/.... finalizing: expected sha256:abc1234ef got sha256:abd1245ef```

Jess: Did the uploader retry logic run? If the client retried the finalization we could end up with a different computed digest depending on chunk boundaries. I can re-trigger a reupload from the artifact store (S3).

SRE-ops: Quick options: 1) Manual pin to last known-good image sha and proceed with canary (fast), 2) Wait for reupload + reverify (safer, adds ~20-30m). If we're inside a change window, pin is acceptable but create follow-up to root-cause multipart finalization.

Michael: Tradeoffs noted. We're in a 30m release window. Preference: pin to last good and proceed, then follow up with a reupload/verify and roll forward if the new artifact is good. Any objections? :eyes:

Tara: +1 for pin. I'll create a ticket to investigate multipart finalization and storage-layer behavior. I'll also attach manual verification checklist for the promote step.

Jess: I'll do the reupload now with a single-part strategy from the original build artifact: `aws s3 cp --no-guess-mime-type --no-cache --expected-sha256 abc1234ef s3://artifacts/redwood/api/staging-2026-03-22.tar.gz` and then run `artifact-verify` against registry. Will post resulting digest here.

ci-bot: Rebuild/reupload job queued: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/88421 — job will disable cache and use single-part upload flag.

deploy-bot: Manual promote allowed by approver `michael`. Pinning promote to `redwood/api@sha:af3b12f9` (last known-good). Canary route will proceed with staged traffic.

Michael: Noting in release notes: "Pinned to last known-good image after staging artifact digest mismatch; follow-up: investigate multipart upload finalization race and add stricter upload/verify checks."

Jess: Reupload finished, registry verify now passes. New artifact digest `sha:abc1234ef` matches expected. I will coordinate a quick verification run in staging then update this thread.

SRE-ops: Recommend adding a post-release job that periodically re-verifies promoted artifacts against origin S3 checksums for 24h to catch silent drift. Filing follow-up infra story.

Michael: Canary looks healthy (10m). Proceeding with full promote. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Jess: Leaving notes: reupload command used, build id 88421, verify logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/logs/88421/verify. Opening follow-up: INFRA-1247 (multipart finalization investigation).

Michael: Closing thread once final promote completes.
